article_context: Body image for the section debunking the idea that tea with milk increases lactation; the milk, crackers, and water-like tabletop still life serves as a calm visual reminder that everyday drinks and snacks do not replace responsive feeding.
image_reading: Overhead still life of a milk bottle, a glass of milk, crackers on small plates, and a striped cloth on a wooden table.
The central glass of milk is the clearest focal object; its visible liquid surface can support subtle natural motion without changing the food arrangement.

models.positive_prompt: Gentle concentric ripples travel across the milk in the central glass and gradually fade; fixed overhead camera on the glass, with the milk surface calm and still in the final frame.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, use the central glass as the focal target in a fixed overhead shot. Fine ripples begin immediately on the milk surface, spread at a measured pace, then diminish naturally so the surface is visibly still near the end; the surrounding bottle, crackers, plates, and cloth remain unchanged.

models.positive_prompt: The milk in the central glass develops soft, slow ripples that spread and settle, ending with a smooth motionless surface. Keep the overhead camera fixed on the glass.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, hold a fixed overhead composition centered on the glass. Let a restrained ripple pattern build across the milk, continue smoothly through most of the shot, and resolve into a calm flat surface in the final moments while the tabletop still life stays intact.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed overhead view: subtle ripples move across the milk in the central glass, then fade completely so its surface is smooth and still at the end.
models.scene_plan: In four seconds, keep the overhead camera fixed with the central glass continuously visible. A small set of gentle ripples moves over the milk with a steady, compact progression and settles by the final frame; all other visible items remain a quiet, unchanged still life.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A calm everyday nutrition image supports the article's evidence-based, reassuring guidance around breastfeeding rather than a promise from a particular drink.
structured_intent.primary_action: Gentle ripples spread across the milk surface and gradually settle.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The tabletop remains a calm, ordinary food-and-drink still life and does not imply that the drink itself increases lactation.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The milk in the central glass has a smooth, visibly motionless surface.
